# Privacy, Provenance & Consistency Checklist: Path-Based Risk Analytics, Trusted Extraction & Advisor-Ready Output

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of requirements for zero-retention, field provenance/trust, cross-source consistency, and multi-underlying scope (areas not covered by `risk-analytics-requirements.md` or `frontend-ui-pdf.md`).
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: Standard (PR/peer review) | **Audience**: Reviewer | **Focus**: Zero-retention & privacy, provenance/trust, cross-source consistency, multi-underlying

## Zero-Retention & Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is "session" precisely defined (tab close, refresh, timeout) for the "not stored after the session" rules on branding and sign-off details? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what, if anything, may be logged server-side (request metadata, errors) without violating zero-retention? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the exact set of data permitted to leave the client for market-data fetches limited to the instrument identifier, and is this stated for every external call (not only vol/history)? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements specified for transmitting the uploaded termsheet to the extraction service (transient processing, no persistence, no third-party training use)? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the requirement that exported documents contain no issuer/distributor/client identity measurable and does it define how identity in free-text source quotes is handled? [Measurability, Spec §US6-4]
- [ ] CHK006 Are browser-side persistence mechanisms (local/session storage, caches, browser print history) explicitly addressed by the zero-retention requirement? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the audit method for SC-009 ("no persisted scenarios, branding, sign-off, documents") defined with a concrete scope of systems audited? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]

## Provenance & Trust Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Is the distinction between "Inferred" and "Conflict" provenance defined consistently, given Key Entities lists four statuses while FR-007 lists three? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the "required fields" for each product type enumerated so that FR-009 blocking is objectively determinable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the format and granularity of the "source text reference" (page, quote length, character offsets) specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for re-extraction or re-upload after the user has confirmed fields (are confirmations preserved or reset)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "User-Verified" status invalidation specified when a confirmed field is later edited? [Coverage, Spec §US2-3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the SC-003 criterion ("no value the user has not seen labelled") traceable to a defined mechanism for assumptions fetched from market data? [Traceability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the benchmark accuracy definitions ("exact match", "genuinely absent") unambiguous for numeric tolerance, date formats and units? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the benchmark report publication location, cadence and format specified, including the source-type proportions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, FR-013]

## Cross-Source Consistency Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are the "places payoff is computed" enumerated so the 100% agreement criterion has a defined denominator? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the "canonical products library" scope (products, scenarios, minimum count) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "seeded simulation statistics identical" defined with respect to random number generator, platform and floating-point behaviour across browser and server? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK019 Are rounding and currency-unit rules defined so the 0.01 tolerance is applied uniformly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK020 Are "stale analytics" detection criteria defined (which assumption changes invalidate results)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026]

## Multi-Underlying & Granularity Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for correlation matrix validity (positive semi-definite) beyond the [-1, 1] bound for baskets of three or more? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the maximum basket size specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK023 Are mixed-currency baskets addressed in requirements or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are weekly accrual requirements defined for holidays and non-trading observation dates? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements for the historical-replay fallback when history is shorter than tenor consistent between Edge Cases and FR-004? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]

## Governance & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK026 Is the resolution criterion for the ADK/constitution rule (comply vs amend) decidable, including who approves the amendment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK027 Are dependencies on external market-data and extraction services documented with availability assumptions and failure behaviour? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the disclaimer-template compliance review requirement ("must be reviewed by compliance") translated into a verifiable release gate? [Traceability, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
